contract.description: The version of this contract the gateway speaks, major.minor: a consumer checks the major.

ts.description: When this message was written (Unix ms): it advances with every heartbeat.

memoryBytes.description: Resident memory of the gateway process, in bytes.

eventLoopLagMs.description: The longest the event loop was late in the last minute, in ms.

clockSteps.description: Wall-clock steps (NTP setting the time) since the gateway started.

temperatureC.description: CPU temperature, where the host has a thermal zone.

throttled.description: Power or thermal conditions a Raspberry Pi reported in about the last minute; empty when none.

throttledWatched.description: The conditions the Pi lets the gateway see.

diskFreeBytes.description: Free space on the buffer's filesystem, in bytes.

reason.description: shutdown when the gateway stopped cleanly; connection-lost from the MQTT last will.

title: Gateway health
description: The payload on site/building/$gateway/<id>/health, retained with QoS 1: online on connect, after a device's status changes and on every heartbeat (health.intervalMs), offline on a clean stop or as the last will.
